messages.author: Tucker Burgin
messages.body:
Bit of a long shot, but has anyone had the chance to run Amber benchmarks
with any of the new NVIDIA Ada cards released this month (RTX 4000 Ada, RTX
4500 Ada, and RTX 5000 Ada)? I am especially interested in whether the 5000
Ada gets a significantly better price-to-performance ratio compared to the
6000 Ada released last year. Thanks!
